newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April refinery operating rates at 83.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan April refinery operating rates at 83.9 pct.

text.p: The utilisation rate of Japanese oil refineries rose to 83.9 percent in April from 82.9 percent in the same month in 1996, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Monday.
Crude throughput amounted to 21.12 million kilolitres (4.43 million barrels per day) in April, up 1.2 percent from the same month in 1996 but down 5.7 percent from March, MITI said.
Japan's oil companies currently have a combined refining capacity of 5.3 million barrels-per-stream-day.
Calculated on a calendar basis, Japan's refining capacity is 4.99 million barrels per day.
